From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: QBR readout alignment — account synopses and consolidated forecast

Team —

As we lock the QBR readout for the execs the week of Apr 12, I need two things from each account owner by EOD Thu (Apr 1):

1) A one-paragraph account synopsis (customer health, top risks, 90-day trigger events).
2) An updated forecast number and confidence band for Q2 (commit / best / upside).

Please put synopses in the shared doc and update the rollup spreadsheet attached. Priorities:
- Top 12 revenue accounts (marked in the sheet)
- Any deal > $250k ARR needs a one-slide summary (owner + next steps)
- If legal/procurement is in flight, add status and expected close date.

I've attached a starter file (Q2_account_synopses_v1.docx) and the current rollup. Laura — can you merge owner inputs into the consolidated forecast and drop the CSV back in this thread? Rishi — can you sanity-check the org-level runway numbers once we have the merges?

I'll run a quick 30-min readout on Apr 4 to validate the deck and call out escalation candidates.

Thanks,
Logan
Logan Wright
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attached is the consolidated forecast CSV and my sanity checks. Short summary:
- Org commit (all owners): $4.12M
- Org best / upside: $4.87M / $5.6M
- Key delta vs prior call: Acme moved from $350k -> $500k (contract scope add), Triton slipped from $420k -> $260k (procurement hold).
- Confidence bands noted per owner in column 'confidence_note'.

I've run the numbers against our burn / capacity model — runway impact is minimal at current utilization but we should flag Triton as an escalation for potential fallthrough.

Thanks all — good progress. Two quick actions before the Apr 4 readout (09:00 PT):

- Laura: please finalize the account synopses and highlight any outstanding owner questions in the doc (I reviewed and left inline comments).
- Marissa: prepare a one-slide summary for Acme (owner: Marissa Cole) with the updated $500k commit and proposed start date; include contract/PO status.
- Grace: take point on Triton escalation; create the short risk memo (1 page) and proposed mitigation (legal + pilot extension).
- Rishi: we'll use your consolidated CSV in the deck — add a single slide that shows commit / best / upside and confidence bands.

Sarah — thanks for the heads up. Marissa will follow up with a firm start date and contract timeline by EOD Apr 5 so you have what finance needs.

I'll run the 30-min readout and share the deck link 30 minutes before the meeting. Appreciate everyone moving quickly on this.

Logan
